digest.component_or_area: Reconcile Bridge git delivery and push retry logic
propositions: Bridge delivery converges but fails after first transport error (TLS/DNS/timeout) without retries, leaving unpushed commits lost to the runner
Current push retry logic in push.py retries only non-fast-forward failures; all other non-zero pushes including transient transport faults terminate on first attempt

Transport fault signatures (certificate verification failed, could-not-resolve-host, connection reset, git timeout 124, promisor fetch failure) must be classified separately from permanent policy violations and made retriable with bounded backoff
Merge recovery leg fails with merge-recovery-blocked reason when promisor on-demand fetch inside git merge hits TLS/network faults, but is not retried
Policy decline failures must remain strictly terminal with exactly one attempt to preserve non-weakening of existing bug 2a76 contract
